name: canopyproof-monitoring-cells
description: 1 km x 1 km monitoring cells. Salts are public demo values; a registry would keep salts private if cell locations are sensitive.

properties.name: Klamath East: Bootleg Fire scar
properties.selection: 1 km cell inside the ACR273 boundary where Hansen GFC records 2021 tree-cover loss (Bootleg Fire, July 2021).
properties.boundary_source: CarbonPlan, 'Simplified boundaries of forest projects participating in California's forest carbon offset program' (Zenodo 8259842, CC BY 4.0), from CARB / ACR public data

properties.name: Klamath East: unburned stand
properties.selection: 1 km cell inside the ACR273 boundary with tree cover >= 30% and no Hansen GFC loss 2017-2024.
properties.boundary_source: CarbonPlan, 'Simplified boundaries of forest projects participating in California's forest carbon offset program' (Zenodo 8259842, CC BY 4.0), from CARB / ACR public data

properties.name: ACR189: coastal conifer stand
properties.selection: 1 km cell inside the ACR189 boundary with tree cover >= 60% and no Hansen GFC loss 2015-2024.
properties.boundary_source: CarbonPlan, 'Simplified boundaries of forest projects participating in California's forest carbon offset program' (Zenodo 8259842, CC BY 4.0), from CARB / ACR public data

properties.name: Amazon frontier, Novo Progresso (PA)
properties.selection: Representative 1 km tropical forest cell near Novo Progresso, Para, Brazil (BR-163 frontier). Not a carbon project. Hansen GFC records 2024 tree-cover loss in about half of it.
properties.boundary_source: Cell chosen by the CanopyProof authors from Hansen GFC; no project boundary
